## Change / reproduction

Describe the user-visible goal and expected behavior. Use synthetic input only.
Do not attach private audio, transcripts, summaries, embeddings, documents,
credentials, device IDs or private diagnostic evidence.

## Verification

| Gate | PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT TESTED | Evidence and scope |
|---|---|---|
| Core / UI-state / speaker identity | | |
| Localization / prompt language / local AI | | |
| Legacy data / cancellation / recovery | | |
| Transport / native codecs | | |
| Packaging / public source / privacy | | |
| Clean full build / release bundle | | |
| Real models / physical hardware / clean user | | |

- [ ] No cloud inference, iOS target or automatic model download/deletion.
- [ ] Original audio, historical requests/results and Codable IDs preserved.
- [ ] Independent transport, worker network denial and resource ownership retained.
- [ ] New files are explicitly public-allowlisted and contain no private data.
- [ ] Dependency pins, licenses/notices and provenance updated where relevant.
- [ ] Documentation states actual acceptance limits; mocks are not physical PASS.
- [ ] No publication or destructive-device action was performed without authorization.
